description: The parse stage: exactly one statement or deny. Comments, stray semicolons, string, dollar-quoted and unicode-escaped literals never add or hide a statement; empty, comment-only and unparseable input denies as parse_error; Postgres-specific syntax parses and reaches the later stages. Converted from the old engine's multi-statement, parse-edges and dialect parse tests; the 1 MiB size cap is not representable in JSON and is left to unit tests.
